description.zh-CN: 右下角的黑底字幕框，一条声音一行，行首行尾的 < > 指出声源方向；新的叠在上面，旧的由白变灰后消失。
description.en: A black subtitle box at the lower right with one line per sound and < > arrows pointing toward the source; new lines stack on top while old ones dim from white to gray and disappear.

hint.zh-CN: Java 版 1.9 加入的字幕框。基岩版的隐藏式字幕（在聊天的对侧、聊天的样式）没有做
hint.en: The subtitle box Java added in 1.9. Bedrock closed captions (chat-styled, opposite the chat) are not implemented

hint.zh-CN: 一行一条，最多 10 条。行尾加空格和 < 或 > 表示声音来自左边或右边，不加表示在正面
hint.en: One per line, up to 10. End a line with a space and < or > for a sound from the left or right; nothing for a sound in front

default.zh-CN:
苦力怕：嘶~ <
脚步声
僵尸：低吼 >
骷髅：咯咯声 <
箱子：开启
default.en:
Creeper hisses <
Footsteps
Zombie groans >
Skeleton rattles <
Chest opens

hint.zh-CN: 相邻两条字幕出现的时间差
hint.en: Time between one subtitle and the next

hint.zh-CN: 每条字幕从出现到消失的时间，期间由白变灰；游戏里默认 3 秒
hint.en: How long each subtitle stays while dimming from white to gray; 3 s by default in the game

hint.zh-CN: 游戏里在右下；左下是镜像过来的，给右边被别的东西占着的画面用
hint.en: Lower right in the game; lower left is mirrored for footage whose right side is occupied

hint.zh-CN: 黑底的不透明度；游戏里是 80%
hint.en: Opacity of the black box; 80% in the game

hint.zh-CN: 一个界面像素对应的设计单位（1080p 的游戏窗口在自动缩放下是 4）；字幕框放不下时自动缩小
hint.en: Design units per GUI pixel (4 for a 1080p window at Auto); shrinks automatically when the box does not fit

hint.zh-CN: 字幕文字默认不带阴影
hint.en: Subtitle text has no shadow by default

hint.zh-CN: 整体淡入。游戏里字幕是直接出现的，这里淡入是为了盖到视频上时不突兀
hint.en: Overall fade in. The game shows subtitles instantly; the fade keeps the overlay from popping onto the footage

hint.zh-CN: 字幕在这段时间里按间隔出现、到时间消失
hint.en: Subtitles appear at the interval and expire during this time

hint.zh-CN: 整体淡出，还没到时间的字幕在这里一起消失
hint.en: Overall fade out; subtitles still showing disappear here together

hint.zh-CN: 每条字幕出现时播放。字幕对应的声音本来在你的视频里，一般留空
hint.en: Plays when each subtitle appears. The sounds the subtitles describe are in your own footage, so this is usually left empty

name.zh-CN: 游戏原始时长（一条 3 秒）
